name: Nuclear Option Radio System (NORS)
author: DSR
description: DCS-SRS-style positional voice radio for Nuclear Option. Multi-radio cockpit with AM/FM frequencies, faction-secure nets driven by the in-game datalink, range falloff, radio horizon, and terrain line-of-sight occlusion. Voice works peer-to-peer over Steam by default (no server needed); an optional standalone relay is supported for large/community servers.
